Projects / Detail card

App overview

Gaming + streaming / Windows 11 x64

PixelBridge

Unpublished draft

PixelBridge brings cloud-service launch links, local emulation, and your own media into a native Windows launchpad requiring .NET Framework 4.8. It is not an independent cloud rendering service: local content runs on your PC. Use direct HDMI to a TV, or separately installed Sunshine and Moonlight for LAN streaming with guided onboarding and diagnostics. A host response is not a successful pairing test. No router WAN port forwarding or UPnP is required for the LAN setup.

No input or HDMI paywall: all usable Xbox controller mappings, standard native profiles and their import/export, and direct-HDMI TV setup are included in every tier. HDMI guidance uses supported Windows display/audio settings, not Sunshine encoding or TV firmware control. Cloud-service latency still applies. Pro adds advanced digital remap editing, saved variants, and custom native subset import/export only.

You supply your accounts, subscriptions, emulators, and legally sourced content. No games, ROMs, BIOS files, keys, or Sunshine installation are bundled. Standard RetroArch profiles are source/schema/round-trip checked, not gameplay-certified. Real customer-key activation, new emulator/controller gameplay, HDMI/audio, and clean-PC Sunshine pairing remain untested acceptance gaps.

Supporter and Pro are one-time purchases. Previously verified access remains usable indefinitely offline; weekly online rechecks and confirmed invalidation affect paid extras, never essential game/controller support. See the product draft for approved Gumroad routes and current prices.
